Before you post, check the date. Per my calendar, November 1, 2026 falls on a **Sunday**, not a Saturday. Confirm which is right, because a wrong day-of-week will send people to your house on the wrong day. I've used "Saturday, November 1" as you wrote it, so change it if needed.

## Main post

**🏡 BIG GARAGE SALE – Saturday, Nov 1, starting at 8am! 🏡**

Hi neighbors! We're cleaning out the garage and the house, and everything has to go. Come see us!

📍 **412 Cedar Lane**
🗓 **Saturday, November 1, starting at 8:00am**
💵 **Cash only, please**

**What we've got:**
🚲 Kids' bikes in a variety of sizes
🪑 Patio set
🍳 Lots of kitchen stuff: cookware, dishes, gadgets, and more

Early birds are welcome, but please don't arrive before 8am. We'll still be setting up! 😊

Please bring small bills if you can, since we'll have limited change. Parking is available on the street, so please be mindful of our neighbors' driveways.

Feel free to share this with anyone who might be interested. We hope to see you Saturday!

## Optional additions
- **End time:** "8am until [time]" tells people when to stop by. I left it out because you didn't give one.
- **Patio set details:** Size, number of chairs, and whether there's an umbrella or cushions. This is your most valuable item, and buyers will ask.
- **Photos:** Add 2–3 photos, such as the bikes lined up, the patio set, and a table of kitchen items. Posts with photos get far more engagement.
- **Rain plan:** "Rain or shine, items will be under cover in the garage."

## Tips for getting more traffic
- **Post at the right times.** Post now, then again Thursday evening as a reminder. Repost in the group, or bump it with a comment such as "Just 2 days to go!"
- **Pin your address in a comment.** Add "412 Cedar Lane" with a Google Maps link, so people don't have to hunt for it.
- **Put up signs.** Use bright, large lettering with an arrow at the nearest main intersection. Facebook posts only reach people who are online, but signs reach everyone driving by.
- **Check whether you need a permit.** Some towns and HOAs require one.
- **Use a pre-written reply to "Is X still available?"** For example: "Yes! Come by Saturday after 8am. We can't hold items, but we'll see you then!"
- **Skip pre-sales.** Early arrivals will pressure you for deals, and "no early birds" stops that.
